text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Still in Love, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it on the table, she stared 
intently at it, completely motionless.
choice_data_list: So you're not going to read it...?
You're not going to read it...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, I'm so sorry. Um, you just took 
me by surprise...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... It really reminded me 
that there truly are people who notice 
me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Of course... I know that there are people 
cheering for me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I stand at the track for a 
race... I can hear the cheers of support.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However, I wonder... even after leaving 
the racetrack, does my figure, my 
shadow... linger in everyone's hearts...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had seemed concerned for some time 
about having a weak presence... True, she 
does have a knack for going unnoticed by 
others, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there are fans who clearly 
recognize Still in Love and cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I feel... a little nervous opening it. 
...I have to open it nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the letter and carefully open 
the seal. Seeing the words written on the 
lovely stationery, I let out a small 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...The address was written by an adult, 
wasn't it? The contents, however... are in 
a young child's handwriting."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You're really good at hide-and-seek, Big 
Sis... I'm always looking for you. Because 
watching you run is so cool."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"When I grow up... I'm gonna be a Trainer. 
And when I do—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Please run with the Umamusume I train. 
I'd be really happy if you run with me 
too, and play hide-and-seek with me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... How pure-hearted can she be?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I want to run a race... worthy of this 
child's pure, innocent heart.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So that I don't lose myself... and get 
swallowed up by instinct...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... As long as you are by my side, I 
have nothing to worry about...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... May this child become a wonderful 
Trainer who is needed by Umamusume... just 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: And then――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Running together, playing hide-and-seek 
together... Maybe we could even become 
friends. ...Fufu."
